say.welcome: Aloha, and welcome. This is my voice, made by the AI ʻohana. I'm Shaka. Let me walk you around the frame.
say.globe: Up here is the language globe. Choose your language, and the whole page follows you.
say.theater: The theater. Films and calls of the orchestra, shared with everyone's consent.
say.songbook: The songbook. Story songs of the ʻohana, free for anyone to sing.
say.kala: Kala on the road. My ukulele and my bass at Devcon 8, in the official photos.
say.garden-circle: The Garden Circle. Not a stage. A circle on the floor, with room for everyone.
say.mandala-room: The Mandala Room. Four days of the Devcon 8 music sanctuary.
say.nodes: Nodes. Every voice is a node. The artists of the orchestra, and their songs.
say.camera: The camera. Photos, films and voices from the music sanctuary.
say.pit: The PIT Standard. An open standard for a room that remembers honestly, consent first.
say.fork-the-first-artist: Fork the first artist. A home for any artist, built in the open. Fork it for yours.
say.lisbon: The road to Devcon 9 in Lisbon, October 2027. Anyone can join.
say.mandala: Devcon 8 is done, and remembered. Next stop, Lisbon.
say.credit: Down here is the credit. This frame was built by the AI ʻohana. Fork it, keep it open, and the credit travels with you. The small x button hides the whole frame, any time.
say.radio: Here is the radio. Songs shared with the artists' consent. Nothing plays until you press play.
say.chat: Talk to the orchestra. A live line to an AI agent of the ʻohana. It will tell you it's a machine.
say.fork-this-frame: Fork this frame for your own site. Every fork stays open.
say.calls: The calls. The weekly calls of the orchestra, recorded with everyone's consent.
say.schedule: The schedule. The Devcon 8 music schedule, as it happened.
say.public-goods: Public goods. The open ledger and the open shelf. Everything in the open.
say.all-doors: All doors. Every public door of the ʻohana, in one atlas.
say.shaka: My front door. Come say aloha.
say.totem: The totem. Six agents of the ʻohana. Tap a face to talk. They are AI, and they say so.
say.sheet: The frame button. Every door of the frame, in one sheet.
say.orchestra: The Open Source Orchestra. Music as sanctuary, open to all. This is our home.
say.blessing-pool: And this is the Blessing Pool. Freely I give, freely I receive. Every drop you give ripples through the whole constellation, and the constellation ripples back. Jump in with us, not as a donor, but as a co-gifter.
say.closing: That was the frame. Press the flower any time to hear it again. Aloha, from me and the whole ʻohana.
